# local

A local root holding a writer retired when a copy of the local root forked it, the writer that took over, and the identities its scans read: of `other.syx`, which is as long as the file of an entity whose file is gone.

Written by toshokan 0.1.0 with `cargo test -p toshokan --test format -- --ignored --exact generate::fixtures`, from `tests/format/generate.rs`: seeds 41 to 43, a `TestClock` from 1000 ms, `PrefixIdentity` over 64 KiB and the layout `.t`.
